decisions.question: CLPD-Q4 timing: the flushBatch list-arm savepoint branch kept in T4 (frozen 11:34, before CHAT-189 was imported at 13:24)
decisions.recommendation: Option A: land night 3 with T4 as frozen, and implement CLPD-Q4 as one unit in the night-4 runner patch (CLP ② bundle); add a dated note in the landing steps and in QUEUE. The branch is unreachable (CHAT-167); CLPD-Q4 moves the savepoint to the runner's derived-history write in that bundle. Option B (remove the branch now) would re-freeze and re-review T4 and split one ruling across two nights. Rule text changed: none; this is timing of an existing ruling.

decisions.question: USO-Q1: the suite version of a closed principal building type (house_with_secondary_suite on Exception 14 lots)
decisions.recommendation: As recommended: when a closure removes the principal building type, the suite version of that type closes with it and reads not_evaluated:no_candidate, with a disclosure. This applies the 150.10 suite permission attaching to a dwelling of a permitted type, and the binding of suite-subject units to the suite class. Cost: one more moved cell on the 6 sample lots plus one evaluator line. Alternative: leave it permitted and disclose a known false permit, about 300 lots citywide (an estimate). Rule text: a dated note on M-169 extending the CHAT-194 closure to the suite class of a closed principal type.
